name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3522: Updates land beside the always-on shadow reader and relaunch quietly beside his game. W leaves fullscreen with the whole window on his screen. The ALT river answers fast (one folder listing, not 34,000 file stats). Triage stands aside for a native D2R on every PC and walks beside a shadow reel. The fleet card says how each PC films, drains and triages, and a renamed host is no longer a ghost PC. Ledger 3.0 P0: a look is a visit, never a frame; Radiance and the Horadric Cube stay filed through a reset; every fall is recorded; his hand ticks are witnesses. The disk floor spares pinned footage. The heart names lost evidence pictures. Cap 75 percent, plus 0 percent, windows tight to their content.
